_doc: Cadet branches (src/systems/cadetBranches.js): a grown younger child of the House (not the heir) sent off — or leaving on their own with their portion — founds a minor House of the blood at a town of the realm. The branch is run by the rival-House AI (systems/rivalHouses.js: trade, court, land, home), with its own purse (the child's portion plus any grant: coin moves, none is made), and a LOYALTY to the main line (0-100) that drifts with how it is treated. Money is gold; days are game days; years are 120 days.
_poorBelow: A branch with less gold than this stays at its seat saving its dues instead of riding to court or market.
_found: Founding: minAge to be sent off; startLoyalty when sent, raised by grantLoyalty for each grantPer gold granted on top of the portion (at most grantLoyaltyMax); ownWayLoyalty when they leave on their own. prestige awarded to the House for planting a branch.
_leave: Once a year an adult child (not the heir, not abroad, holding no office) with a portion of at least minPurse may leave to found a branch of their own (chance), at most one a year, and only while another heir remains.
_sub: Sub-branches: once a year a younger grown child (not the eldest) of a branch head may found a branch of their own with share of the branch's purse (when it holds minGold), one generation further from the main line (loyalty − loyaltyDrop).
_income: The week's dues from the seat town's purse (weekly + perStewardship × the head's stewardship) and the household's spending back into it (weekly + share of the purse).
_loyalty: Yearly drift: yearly (distance grows), neglect when no gift, summons or request in neglectDays, prestigeBonus while the House has prestigeAt Prestige. A new head keeps newHead of the old head's lean from 50, less depth per generation of distance from the main line. Below estrangedBelow the branch breaks with you (feud = (50 − loyalty) × 2), and is reconciled at reconcileAt. attacked: falling on their retinue.
_gift: A gift raises loyalty by gold / perLoyalty (at most maxLoyalty); a second gift within recentDays counts for recentFactor of that.
_ask: Requests by letter: gold (share of their purse, at least min; costs loyaltyCost; refused below needLoyalty, which costs refuse), men (a levy for the war, see aid), summons (the head rides to you and stays some days: loyalty and Prestige). cooldown days between asks of one kind.
_tribute: A loyal branch (loyalty ≥ loyalty) with more than reserve gold sends share of the surplus to the main line every `every` days.
_aid: War aid: while you are at war, a branch at loyalty or above sends a levy of men (base + perMartial × the head's martial strength, + their hired guards) for `days` days, paying them wage a man a week out of its own purse (into the seat town's). Unasked at most every `every` days.
_estranged: An estranged branch speaks against you at court (whisper reputation, never below 0) and may press a claim at your succession (house._pendingClaim; its feud joins the rival claimants').
_marriage: When a branch child weds out, rivalChance that it is into a rival House with a grown child free: that rival's feud with you eases by feud.
